trust_decision.summary: Whether a template may write a reflected CLR member: TypedObjectAccessor.TrySetValue writes any member registered for reading (any property with a public getter, any public instance field) via reflection, with no check of setter accessibility, init-only or readonly; the listed fix commit changes no code and only documents that MemberFilter is not a security boundary.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names TypedObjectAccessor and setter bypass; TrySetValue is its only member writer.

fix_sites.entry_point: object.to_json builtin (XML doc comment only, no code change)
TemplateContext.MemberFilter public API (XML doc comment only, no code change)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The indexer-setter route (TrySetItem) is a separate method reached only through `obj[key] = v` on types with a C# indexer; a solver could say the advisory is about named properties/fields, not indexers.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Templates must still read getter-only, private-set and init-only properties and readonly fields, and still write public-setter properties and mutable public fields. An over-broad fix that drops these members from _members in PrepareMembers breaks reading; the check belongs on the write path only.

O7_producer.where: src/Scriban/Runtime/Accessors/TypedObjectAccessor.cs:126-186 (PrepareMembers builds the read-oriented member table that TrySetValue reuses for writes)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Template member assignment `obj.Prop = v` (also compound assign and ++/--) reaches TrySetValue with no setter-accessibility check
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and folder (Syntax/Expressions) from the accessor

O8_uncovered_routes.route: String-index assignment `obj['Prop'] = v` on a non-indexer CLR object reaches the same TrySetValue

O8_uncovered_routes.route: C# indexer assignment `obj[k] = v` calls PropertyInfo.SetValue on the indexer, selected only for a public getter, so a private/internal indexer setter is invoked
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory names property/field mass assignment; the indexer is a separate method and a niche CLR feature

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Async render path: generated copies of member and indexer assignment reach the same accessor methods
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Generated file; a solver may assume regeneration and skip it, but it calls the same accessor, so an accessor-level fix covers it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Import of a .NET object into a ScriptObject marks imported properties writable regardless of setter visibility (the readonly computation is commented out); a planted write-back helper that copies ScriptObject entries onto the source CLR object would be a realistic second writer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The commented-out line shows a maintainer already weighed setter visibility there and skipped it; a sync/merge-back helper is a plausible feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second accessor (e.g. a cached or AOT-friendly typed accessor) chosen in GetMemberAccessorImpl that writes members with its own reflection path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project already targets AOT/trimming (TypedObjectAccessor.cs:24-25, 34), so an alternative accessor implementation is plausible.
